# Membrane solver v3 — lane/graph cooperativity (generated by run_all_v3.py)

Implementer: Grace (Claude Fable 5.1), 18 Oct 2026 evening. Base: v2 code (`energy.py`) + one term. HEAD `3e6fc8c`. Gradients FD-checked with the lane factor active (max rel err 7.7e-8).

## 0. The term

For contact (i, j) with c_ij common contact partners (triangles of the bond graph), the adhesion density is multiplied by **f_ij = 1 + λ·c_ij** (`linear`; variant `sat`: 1 + λ·min(c,2)/2). Mode `triplet`: only triplet (np) contacts are boosted — a singlet pair fuses no lane (ruling F4); mode `all`: every contact. c_ij is a property of the contact graph, piecewise constant in the coordinates; the gradient is exact within a branch. **One new constant, λ, set on ⁴He.** E₀ from D (λ does not enter D: c = 0). r = e₀·4πR_p²/E₀ and δ scanned, κ = 0.2 E₀.

## 1. Added at build time

| # | what | why |
|---|---|---|
| C1 | Rows r ≥ 1 retired; **r ∈ {0.1, 0.3}** | at r = 1 the lane factor drives ⁴He into engulfment before BE_He4 is reached (skin too soft: E₀ ≈ 8 MeV). The physical regime is r ≪ 1 — E₀ of order the ~600 MeV bubble scale (16 Oct), e₀ of order MeV/fm². |
| C2 | D and ⁴He(λ = 0) states cloned across variants | λ-independent; saves a third of the compute |
| C3 | engulfment rule applied to every ⁴He trial | F3 |

**Readings.** (i) The same-species patch is the thin one in both T (nn: raw 0.431 vs 0.54, d 1.70 vs 1.62) and ³He (pp: 0.411, d 1.665) — P3 of the physics spec appears as a *consequence* of 'a singlet fuses no lane', not as an input. (iii) Hub-half fractions 0.45–0.58, no consistent fat end at the hub: the egg ruling is still not reproduced.
